---
title: "Starter Analysis Exercise"
subtitle: "A beginner R analysis of life expectancy, infant mortality, and population"
---

::: {.project-hero}
This exercise uses the `gapminder` data from the `dslabs` R package to practice data selection, visualization, missing-data checks, and simple linear modeling.

[View the R Markdown source file](https://github.com/yangyin-zeng/starter-analysis-exercise/blob/master/starter_analysis_exercise.Rmd){.button .primary}
:::

## Project Summary

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Question

How are infant mortality, population, and life expectancy related among African countries?
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Methods

The analysis filters African country data, compares selected variables with scatterplots, checks missing infant mortality values by year, and fits simple linear models for the year 2000.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Results

The plots suggest that higher infant mortality is associated with lower life expectancy, which is then tested with a simple linear model.
:::
:::
